title: Bound common-force contraction inside a fixed Galerkin model
statement: In real divergence-free Fourier cube V_N, dimension2[(2N+1)^3-1], Euler nonlinearity has zero phase-space divergence and additive forcing has zero state derivative. Thus Vol(Phi_tau(E))=exp(-nu tau tr A_N)Vol(E) for any prescribed additive force. Mapping the WHOLE L2 R-ball into epsilon-ball requires epsilon>=R exp[-4pi^2 nu tau (2N+1)^3 N(N+1)/((2N+1)^3-1)]. First-shell Galerkin projection gives epsilon>=M/sqrt(1+4pi^2) exp(-4pi^2 nu tau). This is not a full-PDE negative; a successful infinite-PDE mechanism can transfer energy to dissipative higher modes.
